currentTarget: Nombre maximal de clients existants simultanés

rootTarget: Nombre maximal de clients de versions antérieures pouvant se connecter simultanément
advisoryAlternative: Nombre maximal de clients de versions antérieures pouvant se connecter simultanément
advisoryIssue: The proposal leaves “legacy” in English. Here it means clients running older software versions; French wording would be clearer for users who do not use the English loan term.
rootRationale: The Bridge setting counts simultaneous clients running earlier software versions; make the older-version meaning explicit instead of leaving “legacy” in English.
